name: Cucco Wranglers Minigame
description: A minigame in which players must catch all Cuccos and throw them into a 6×6 fenced area located directly next to the NPC.
InternalName: ニワトリ探し追い込みNPC

fields.name: Required Cucco Count
fields.description: Sets the number of Cuccos that players must catch during the minigame.

fields.name: Activation Variable
fields.description: The local variable to set when the minigame's time limit expires.
